from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    bad = [] if ok else ['REF-MISMATCH']
    if manual:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            if gv != v: bad.append(f"{k}={gv!r} want {v!r}")
    print(f"== {name}: {'OK' if not bad else 'PROBLEM ' + '; '.join(bad)}")

# transport CLOSE at I level -> PEER_CLOSE with canonical incl. reason
cl = bytes([0x1c]) + W.v(7) + W.v(3) + W.v(2) + b'hi'
tr = trace([datagram(envelope('I', 0, cl), auth=[0])])
check("close-at-I", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PEER_CLOSE', 'closed.offset':0, 'closed.code':'PEER_CLOSE'})

# MAX_STREAM_DATA monotone + after stop
msd1 = bytes([0x11]) + W.v(0) + W.v(9)
stop = bytes([0x05]) + W.v(0) + W.v(4)
msd2 = bytes([0x11]) + W.v(0) + W.v(5)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, msd1+stop+msd2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("msd-monotone", tr, {'streams.0.send_max':9, 'streams.0.stop':4})

# PING + PADDING bytes count as separate frames; trailing padding after lengthless? no
pad = b'\x00\x00\x01\x00'
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, pad, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("pad-ping", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK'})

# ACK at H level merges with A level union separately
def ackf(la, first, pairs, typ=2):
    out = bytes([typ]) + W.v(la) + W.v(0) + W.v(len(pairs)) + W.v(first)
    for g, r in pairs: out += W.v(g) + W.v(r)
    return out
tr = trace([dict(keys=['I','H','A']),
            datagram(envelope('H', 0, ackf(3, 0, [])), auth=[0]),
            datagram(envelope('A', 0, ackf(5, 0, []), auth=[0])])
check("ack-levels", tr, {'acknowledged.1.count':1, 'acknowledged.2.count':1})

# STOP twice retains first error
st1 = bytes([0x05]) + W.v(0) + W.v(2)
st2 = bytes([0x05]) + W.v(0) + W.v(9)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, st1+st2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("stop-twice", tr, {'streams.0.stop':2})
EOF
